faces.effect_text:
[Special Digivolution Condition] [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[TS] trait: Cost 5
[Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Aegiochusmon] in name: Cost 1 for each of your security cards
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash your top security card and 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -13000 DP until their turn ends. Then, if you have 1 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +2 ≪Deck≫＞.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, trash your opponent's top security card.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [TS] trait Digimon or Tamers would leave the battle area, by trashing your top security card, they don't leave.

qa.answer: It can digivolve for digivolution cost of 0.
qa.question:
I have 0 security cards.
What is the digivolution cost if I use this card's 3rd digivolution requirement to digivolve from a level 5 card with [Aegiochusmon] in its name?
Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] to reduce the DP of 1 of my opponent's Digimon even when I have 0 security cards and therefore can't trash one?

qa.answer:
No, it isn't deleted yet.
Once all of the processing for the activated effect has resolved, a rule check will occur, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.
qa.question:
This card's effect caused the DP of my opponent's Digimon to become 0.
At such times, is the Digimon with a DP of zero deleted?

qa.answer:
[Security] effects take precedence for activation.
Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation.
For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
qa.question: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

qa.answer:
This effect triggers and can be activated when a Digimon or Tamer specified by it leaves the battle area under the specified conditions.
When activated, all Digimon and Tamers matching its trigger conditions are prevented from leaving.
qa.question: What does this card's second [All Turns] effect do, exactly?
